summary: rollup / warehouse coiling door: missing_hardware; runner_off_guide

findings.part: roll-up curtain and its coiling guides
findings.description: The curtain does not coil: it rises as one rigid slab and at full open sits entirely above its side guides and above the drum hood, with its top edge past the top of the wall and nothing on either side holding it. Measured: guides end at the opening head, the curtain at full open spans from there to 2.1-3.6 m above them.
The caption says the pull_ring is on both sides. Only one face carries it: the other hardware close-up shows a blank leaf. A robot approaching from that side has nothing to take hold of.
